title: Finite fibres and residue extensions of the affine Stein factor
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $f:X\to S$ a proper morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put $B=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, and let $X\xrightarrow{q}\operatorname{Spec}B\xrightarrow{\pi}S$ be its canonical Stein factorization [def-weil-pbc-stein-factorization]. For every $s\in S$, the set $\pi^{-1}(s)$ is finite, and for each $b\in\pi^{-1}(s)$ the residue field extension $\kappa(b)/\kappa(s)$ is finite-dimensional [def-weil-residue-field] [def-pc-field-extension]. No Noetherian hypothesis on $A$ is imposed.
